passages.context: The shorter-recension column was inspected under chapter VII. It says that the opponents abstain from Eucharist and prayer because they do not confess the Eucharist to be the flesh of Jesus Christ that suffered for sins and was raised by the Father; it then counsels separation from their teaching. The interleaved long-recension expansion is not used.
passages.notes: The exact OCR and identified 1887 edition control attribution and bounded sense, not a critical Greek text. The passage is not a direct commentary on John 6.
